log_transform.rule: no negative observed values AND median of observed values > 50 -> detected as linear scale, log2-transformed
log_transform.zero_handling: an observed value of exactly 0 is treated as not-detected (NaN), never log2(0)
log_transform.evidence: T1 NB1b: skipping log2 cost about 3 points of accuracy in simulation

notes: min_observed_genes: T1 NB1b's accuracy-vs-observed-genes curve shows chance-level accuracy below 100 observed genes and stable accuracy from about 200 on; 100-300 is thinly sampled in that curve, so 200 is evidence-backed, not an arbitrary placeholder, but still worth revisiting once more of that range is sampled (docs/plans/nb1b/). mask_convention: T1 NB1b's 2x2 ablation confirmed per-cell masking beats dataset-level median fill by 3.2 points unrestricted and 4.7 points oracle-restricted in simulation -- settled, not pending further ablation.

known_limitations.hardcoded_supported_classes: CROSS_MODAL_SUPPORTED_CLASSES = (macrophage, monocyte) means every non-myeloid upload (T cell, NK cell, etc.) can only ever be labelled macrophage or monocyte, or abstain -- never its true lineage. Not fixed by any preprocessing choice in this file. Owner: T1 NB2 (label space estimation).
